rationale: FP16_Optimizer skips TP-sliced grads as if replicated, undercounting global_grad_norm by sqrt(tp_size). Borderline gradient_sync vs communication: per anti-example 3, root cause is wrong reduction mask (which slices to sum), not group config, so gradient_sync. Detection compares TP=k norm to TP=1 reference, requires topology and only valid for TP-sliced params, so pi_topo+pi_precond=true.
